Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week. We're very keen to accelerate the mutual action plan (MAP) so we can get a pilot running in July. Two asks from the security/ops side before we proceed to procurement:

1) Clear timeline for SOC 2 evidence — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a current SOC 2 Type II bridge letter and a copy of the control matrix by next week?

2) SIG/CAIQ snapshot — our security team wants a completed SIG/CAIQ or CAIQ extract that maps to the MAP milestones (staging, pilot, prod).

3) DPA redlines — legal has a couple of redlines around data residency and retention (they want explicit language for 7-year transaction archival for regulated flows). Can we get an initial redline from Redwood to start parallel review?

Can you send a short checklist + ownership (who on your side will own SOC 2 evidence, who will take the DPA redline) so we can align on a 4-week sprint?

Lina

Quick answers up front:

- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a CAIQ export and can produce a targeted SIG matrix mapped to the MAP milestones (staging/pilot/prod) — Marissa will lead that work and deliver a mapped spreadsheet by 2025-06-11.
- DPA redlines: Rafael will send an initial redline that addresses residency/retention options tomorrow. We typically propose: default 3-year operational retention, with costed archival to support regulated 7-year retention in cold storage (customer-requested export/escrow).

Proposed next steps (short):
1) Rafael to share DPA redline (tomorrow).
2) Kimberly to upload SOC 2 bridge + control extract (by 6/9).
3) Marissa to deliver SIG/CAIQ-to-MAP mapping (by 6/11).
4) Joint call to sync on outstanding asks (propose 6/12).

If that timeline works, we'll push the MAP into a 4-week sprint and flag any blocking items.

Best,
Jonas

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Jun 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redline draft + options for 7-year archival

Hi Lina / team — attaching a first-pass DPA redline (DPA-redline-bluecoil.docx). Key points we highlighted in the redline: 

- Residency: option A (hosted EU region) or option B (hosted US region) — we can contractually guarantee region for production workloads.
- Retention: default operational retention = 3 years for customer-generated training/transactional artifacts. For regulated archival (7 years) we propose an addendum: archival-as-a-service where data is moved to encrypted cold storage with an export/escrow process on termination. This avoids long-term hot storage costs while meeting compliance.
- Audit access: SOC 2 attestations + CAIQ/SIG extracts will be made available in our secure share; on-site or enhanced evidence packages can be scheduled for enterprise customers under an SOW.

Open items we need your input on:
1) Is BlueCoil comfortable with archival-as-a-service in lieu of hot 7-year retention?
2) Any language your legal team requires around right-to-audit or escrow that isn't covered in section 6?

I'll be available for a 30-min legal sync tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Rgds,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
